title: Gold Bar XL Summer Berries Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Kit in Summer Berries blends a medley of ripe Berry flavours into a bright, fruit-forward vape with natural sweetness and just a hint of tang. Smooth on the draw with layered fruit notes throughout, It's an easy pick for fans of all-day fruit blends. Each kit includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill reservoir, preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid to deliver smooth and consistent MTL performance. Designed for the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit, this refill format is mess-free and easy to install. The pods integrated mesh coil helps preserve the nuance and clarity of the mixed berry flavour while maintaining satisfying vapour output. Once the contents are depleted, simply replace with another from the Gold Bar XL range.
